summary.one_line: The prospective player install guides match their source packages and clearly withhold release/live-validation claims.

purpose.evidence: Read all six changed player-page Markdown paths. The Mods catalog now says player packages are prepared but unpublished; the two mod pages give simple prospective ZIP install/use/remove steps, keeping developer builds in the separate devkit section. Both products remain explicitly awaiting in-game acceptance of their new launch paths.

structure.evidence: Catalog remains a landing page; predictor and bank pages now declare how-to, with prerequisites, four player steps, troubleshooting, removal, usage and limitations. Each RU/EN pair mirrors the same sections. The final bank example cites the calculation diary entry #banks rather than incorrectly using the renderer-counter entry; the historical live-card claim was removed from the numerical table.

specificity.evidence: The predictor steps name Heroes5DeploymentPreview, workshop_preview_loader.exe and its adjacent WorkshopDeploymentPreview.dll, file-picker H5_Game.exe, ordinary battle/hover/RMB and ordinary-EXE disable. The bank steps name Heroes5BankReference, workshop_bank_reference.exe plus matching workshop-army-reference.h5u, no overwrite of a different UserMODs file, and H5U/folder removal. Both say Code → Download ZIP is source rather than the unpublished player archive. Bank imp-cache reference ranges T1 90-135, T2 120-165, T3 150-195 and T4 180-225 match the linked #banks calculation record and are not presented as a detected hidden tier.

reproducibility.evidence: The website describes package 0.1.0-preview.1 as prepared, not released. Parent reports site checks before the final four-line citation correction: 8 Node, 23 Python, 41 HTML and 13 browser tests passed; the link gate was to rerun on final HEAD. Bank source's six no-game checks include real InstallPackage tempdir copy/repeat/refusal, while predictor source checks no-args/--check packaging without a fresh battle. I did not start either mod or confirm player double-click behavior in game.

evidence.evidence: Compared the player instructions with the reviewed predictor and bank source READMEs/loaders: adjacent folder search/file-picker cancel and pinned game hashes are implemented; bank installer copies a matching H5U, refuses foreign content, and normal launches avoid the selector. The new bank table now states public calculation and links the diary's #banks entry, which actually contains the 15-slot tier bounds. Older #army-tooltip-probe describes renderer calls, so using it for numeric bounds would have been incorrect; final text no longer does so.

applicability.evidence: Both pages require the supported Universe build and warn that prepared player ZIPs are not publicly downloadable or stable until live launch acceptance. They do not require Python/Git/compiler for future compiled packages, and developer source builds remain linked separately. Predictor/Bank combined use and broader bank coverage remain unverified; no claim is made that CI or --check replaces gameplay.

translations.evidence: RU and EN catalog, predictor and bank pairs agree on preview.1 prepared/unpublished status, source ZIP warning, folder/executable names, file-picker behavior, bank no-overwrite and removal, candidate result checks, and no-live-validation caveat. Both bank pages change the tier-example wording and link to #banks calculation source. No substantive translation mismatch found.

maintenance.evidence: The player pages stay under the separate Mods section with existing URLs and how-to metadata. They add instructions without copying the developer CMake/Python build steps, linking the canonical devkit section instead. The bank example references one canonical calculation record. review:info lists exactly six changed Markdown paths; no source or game file was edited by this reviewer.
